title: Compare two folders of forty config files
prompt: The folders old/ and new/ each hold 40 config files with the same names: lines of key = value (spaces around = do not matter, key order does not matter, # starts a comment). Write diff.csv with the header file,key,old,new and a row for each key whose value differs between old/ and new/ (a key in only one folder has an empty old or new), sorted by file name, then key, in plain text order.
